name: Dokploy
description: Self-hostable PaaS for deploying apps and databases (Next.js dashboard, Docker Swarm and Traefik).

install: mise use node@24 && npm i -g node-gyp && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

set -a; . /etc/homemade/env; set +a; rest=${HOMEMADE_URL#https://}; rest=${rest#"$HOMEMADE_PROJECT-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME"}; rest=${rest%.$HOMEMADE_VM_DOMAIN}; [ -f apps/dokploy/.env ] || { cp apps/dokploy/.env.example apps/dokploy/.env; printf 'BETTER_AUTH_URL=https://%s-%s-3000%s.%s
BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=%s
' "$HOMEMADE_PROJECT" "$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME" "$rest" "$HOMEMADE_VM_DOMAIN" "$(openssl rand -hex 32)" >> apps/dokploy/.env; }; grep -q allowedDevOrigins apps/dokploy/next.config.mjs || sed -i 's|reactStrictMode: true,|reactStrictMode: true,
	allowedDevOrigins: ["*.onhmmd.com", "*.onhomemade.com"],|' apps/dokploy/next.config.mjs

docker swarm init --advertise-addr "$(hostname -I | cut -d' ' -f1)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker start dokploy-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name dokploy-postgres -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=dokploy -e POSTGRES_DB=dokploy -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=amukds4wi9001583845717ad2 -v dokploy-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data postgres:16 >/dev/null; until docker exec dokploy-postgres pg_isready -U dokploy -h 127.0.0.1 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; sleep 3
pnpm --filter=dokploy run migration:run && pnpm run server:script
